delta.purpose: Prevent implicit image /etc/group memberships from widening the manifest-declared supplemental group identity around persistent volumes.

external_primary_evidence.kubernetes: Current official Kubernetes security-context/API documentation defines Merge as the default supplemental group policy and Strict as excluding implicit image /etc/group memberships; the feature is GA in Kubernetes 1.35.
external_primary_evidence.kata: Current upstream Kata releases/latest was rechecked during this go and resolved to immutable release 4.0.0; the repository rolling-release/fresh-advisory acceptance rule remains necessary.

counterhypothesis.falsifier: Admit the exact deployment on the selected target, verify supplementalGroupsPolicy support/effective process identity, inspect effective UID/GID/supplemental groups, and exercise create/write/fsync/read/rename/delete on both persistent mounts before and after full appliance replacement.
